title: hypericum alpinum var. alpigenum
intro: Hypericum alpinum var. alpigenum, commonly known as Alpine St. John's Wort, is a plant species belonging to the Hypericum genus. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, with reported health benefits including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects, which may help to soothe skin irritations, wounds, and infections. The therapeutic actions of Alpine St. John's Wort include its ability to modulate the immune system and exhibit neuroprotective properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and naphthoquinones, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
